products.name: Pink Cherry Blossom Print Shirt
products.description: A soft pink short-sleeve shirt with a cherry blossom print in deeper pink. It has a classic collar, contrast black buttons and a curved hem that looks good tucked in or worn loose. Great for brunch, dates and weekend outings.

products.name: Black Embroidered Patch Polo
products.description: A black polo with a cream tipped collar and striped cuffs, finished with embroidered floral patches on the chest and lower front. A stand-out polo that pairs well with white or beige trousers.

products.name: Cream Striped Tipped Polo
products.description: A cream textured polo with thin brown vertical stripes and brown tipping on the collar and cuffs, plus a small chest badge. Clean and classy for work, church or a relaxed day out.

products.name: Grey Striped Tipped Polo
products.description: A grey textured polo with fine vertical stripes, black and white tipping on the collar and cuffs, a two-button placket and a small chest badge. A smart everyday polo that goes with jeans, chinos or shorts.

products.name: Tan Marble Print Polo
products.description: A white polo with a tan marble print, finished with an olive collar, olive cuffs and a four-button placket. Easy to style with black or khaki trousers for a sharp casual look.

products.name: GAIN Scripture Print T-Shirt
products.description: A white crew-neck T-shirt with a brushed olive and black print and a bold GAIN graphic on the chest with Isaiah 41:10 written below it. Faith-inspired and easy to wear every day.

products.name: White Rose Print Shirt
products.description: A white short-sleeve shirt printed with dark brown roses and leaves. It has a classic collar and button front. Pair it with black trousers or jeans for a cool, put-together look.

products.name: Pink Tree Print Shirt
products.description: A white short-sleeve shirt with a watercolour print of pink and green trees around the hem and sleeves, a chest pocket and a button front. A statement shirt for outings, vacations and parties.

products.name: Black Cartoon Print Polo
products.description: A black polo with a playful cartoon print on the chest and lower front. Classic collar, two-button placket and side slits at the hem. Fun and easy for casual days.

products.name: Lilac Graphic Print Polo
products.description: A lilac polo with a colourful graphic print on the chest. It has a classic collar and a three-button placket. A soft, standout colour for casual outings.

products.name: Rust Classic Polo
products.description: A plain rust polo with a clean collar and a short single-button placket. A simple, warm colour that pairs well with beige, black or denim.

products.name: White Floral Embroidered Shirt
products.description: A white textured short-sleeve shirt with a camp collar and tan floral embroidery all over. Light and breezy, great for weddings, outings and holidays.

products.name: Blue Pocket Polo
products.description: A blue polo with a chest pocket, a two-button placket and ribbed cuffs. A wardrobe basic for work, school runs and weekends.

products.name: Black Pocket Polo
products.description: A black polo with a chest pocket, a three-button placket and ribbed cuffs. Goes with everything, from jeans to chinos.

products.name: Pastel Floral Print Shirt
products.description: A white short-sleeve shirt covered in big pastel flowers in pink, blue, yellow and grey, with contrast black buttons. Bright and fun for beach days, vacations and parties.

products.name: Navy PROJEKT Ribbed T-Shirt
products.description: A navy ribbed crew-neck T-shirt with a washed look and a tan PROJEKT print on the chest. A relaxed fit with dropped shoulders for an easy streetwear vibe.

products.name: Grey PROJEKT Ribbed T-Shirt
products.description: A grey ribbed crew-neck T-shirt with a washed look and a brown PROJEKT design on the chest. A relaxed fit with dropped shoulders, made for easy everyday wear.

products.name: White Embroidered Border Shirt
products.description: A white textured short-sleeve shirt with rich brown embroidered borders down the front and around the sleeves. Smart and cultural, great for Fridays, church and celebrations.

products.name: Cream Embroidered Camp Collar Shirt
products.description: A cream textured shirt with a camp collar and black and gold embroidered panels down the front. A stylish, relaxed shirt for Fridays, outings and events.

products.name: Plum Pocket Polo
products.description: A plum polo with a chest pocket, a two-button placket and ribbed cuffs. A rich colour that stands out from the usual basics.

products.name: Blue Geometric Print Shirt
products.description: A short-sleeve shirt in shades of blue with bold geometric bands of diamonds, stars and squares. It has a button-down collar and a curved hem. A standout shirt for Fridays, outings and events.

products.name: Navy and Red Plaid Long Sleeve Shirt
products.description: A navy long-sleeve shirt with a red and white check, two flap chest pockets with snap buttons and a snap-button front. Wear it buttoned up or open over a tee, with the sleeves rolled for a relaxed look.

products.name: Burgundy Zip Neck Tipped Polo
products.description: A burgundy polo with a half-zip neck and white tipping on the collar and cuffs. Sporty and smart at the same time, it pairs well with white, black or beige trousers.

products.name: Brown PROJEKT Ribbed T-Shirt
products.description: A brown textured ribbed crew-neck T-shirt with a cream PROJEKT print on the chest. A relaxed fit with dropped shoulders that looks great with white or cream bottoms.

products.name: Burgundy PROJEKT Velvet-Look T-Shirt
products.description: A burgundy crew-neck T-shirt with a rich velvet-look ribbed texture and a gold PROJEKT print on the chest. Dressy enough for nights out, easy enough for everyday.

products.name: Green PROJEKT Ribbed T-Shirt
products.description: A green ribbed crew-neck T-shirt with a dark brushed pattern and a gold PROJEKT print on the chest. A bold, relaxed tee that pairs well with black trousers.

products.name: Black Embroidered Camp Collar Shirt
products.description: A black textured shirt with a camp collar and cream embroidered panels running down the front. Sharp and stylish for Fridays, outings and events, especially with white trousers.
